causes.title: Failure exit code not mapped: no fast retry, about 24 hours to the next attempt
causes.symptom: Removed from the beta scripts repo; see the full kit.
rankedCauses: Exit code not in the return-code table, so IME treats it as failed. Field sources (Barbat; Ooms) report it then skips the three fast retries and waits on the global re-evaluation schedule, about 24 hours (M5-1). Learn documents the 3 x 5-minute Retry behaviour and the 24-hour cadence, not the skip itself.

contextSignals.meaning: Installer returned a success code (Learn default return codes).
Summary of a success exit code.
Detected after install: the healthy end state.
Not detected before install, so IME goes on to install. Normal.
Already detected before install, so IME skips the install. Normal for an installed app; if you expected a newer version, run again with -ExpectNewVersion (KC-002).
Not detected after install. Becomes KC-001 when paired with a success exit code; otherwise read the exit code entry.
Success, install command received, in progress, or downloaded and waiting (community-decoded).
Normal IME steps: policy received, content download, IMECache, state reporting, retry schedule check.
Raw EnforcementState not decoded by the kit (only codes with two independent sources are decoded).
